# BestAIAgent.in — Machine-readable site map

## Site identity
Canonical: https://bestaiagent.in/
Language: en-IN
Purpose: independent AI agent discovery and evidence-led comparison.

## Primary user journeys
1. Discover agents by task or category.
2. Compare shortlisted tools across capabilities, pricing, deployment, privacy, integrations, evidence quality, and India Fit.
3. Learn how the editorial methodology works.
4. Read India-specific adoption guidance.

## Homepage sections
- Hero: search and discovery
- Categories: Coding, Automation, Research, Voice, Frameworks, Sales & support
- Directory: curated agent cards with editorial score, India Fit, price context, and evidence count
- Comparison workspace
- India Fit methodology
- Editorial methodology
- Learning field guides
- Decision CTA

## Current featured examples
- Claude Code — Anthropic — Coding
- Cursor — Anysphere — Coding
- Lindy — Lindy.ai — Automation
- CrewAI — CrewAI — Frameworks
- n8n — n8n GmbH — Automation
- Vapi — Vapi — Voice

## Evaluation signals
- Editorial score
- India Fit
- Pricing model
- Evidence count
- Deployment model
- Privacy/compliance signals
- Integrations and workflow fit

## Editorial safeguards
- No pay-to-rank claim is used in the interface.
- Scores are editorial assessments.
- Product claims should be tied to evidence and reviewed periodically.
- INR context must be distinguished from official local pricing.
- Do not infer certification, endorsement, partnership, or rating claims without direct evidence.

https://bestaiagent.in/#compare
